hypothesis: Four independent within-row f64 accumulators can cheaply enclose the canonical sequential score. A conservative analytic rounding radius supplies a lower-bound cutoff; only rows whose upper bounds overlap that cutoff need canonical scoring. This may remove the serial-addition bottleneck while preserving every result bit.
mechanism: For 1<=d<=4096, finite stored f32 values and finite normalized query coordinates with absolute value <=1, use radius 8*d*d*f64::EPSILON*max(abs(row)). Outward-round the final interval endpoints and clamp to [-1,1]. Use the kth largest lower endpoint only as an exclusion threshold; equality is retained. Re-score all overlapping rows with the unchanged Embedding::cosine and retain existing candidate-limit/fusion/tie rules. Unexpected dimensions or nonfinite estimates use [-1,1].
controls: Preserved bounded product; failed owner-membership candidate with canonical scoring; owner-membership candidate with certified arithmetic. Same rotated three-way 36-cell/3456-query exposed-input cohort and 6912 full-result comparisons. No production edits.
preflight: Existing captured-owner mutation and candidate-limit boundaries plus dimension/reduction boundaries, cancellation, extreme finite f32 values, f32/f64 subnormals, signed zeros, near-ties and minimum-score boundaries. Every finite canonical score must lie in its computed interval. Point-box and low-dimensional pruning tests remain required.
decision: Require identical full results everywhere, at least 1.25x median speedup over the preserved product in every nonempty filtered corpus cell, and <=15% regression in all other controls. This is a new, stronger screen than the preceding 1.10x micro-optimization gate. Record screened and canonically re-scored row counts, including tie-heavy failures to prune. No retry solely to cross a timing threshold.
resources: All input/compilation/timing remains local/free. Use only training vectors and exposed calibration queries. Start native compilation/timing after the Android qualification has stopped. Preserve all preceding failures, sources and raw results.
limits: Floating-point error bounds, selective exact evaluation and parallel reduction are established techniques. This is an engineering hypothesis, not an originality claim, competitive qualification, or proof of a useful memory architecture. The repeated-text development payload remains unlike the serving benchmark.
